            AI Supremacy 

SubscribeSign inGuides 🦮All of Google's AI Products and Tools

A 2025 tour of Google's AI progress. 

Michael SpencerSep 10, 2025∙ Paid94217ShareI’ve been studying this past week Google’s incredible 2025 of AI product releases and if you feel behind, you are not alone. In the scattered bureaucracy that is Google, there is light. 

There’s a lot to unpack. When they doubled down on LLMs and related products since ChatGPT, they weren’t joking. Nearly three years later, we starting to see the full force of the results. We are starting in mid to late 2025 to see the fruits of their labor. I want to take you on a quick tour where you can dive in deeper if you see something interesting. My hope is this will enable you to familiarize yourself better with what Google’s AI ecosystem is becoming and what they are up to in AI products. 

Why Read this? 📚

So if you like discovering AI tools, you might enjoy this article. But I go into some of Google’s research ambitions too near the end. 

This article/directory of Google AI products can help you explore everything from Google Deep Think to tools out of Google Labs you’ve never heard of. Or perhaps you have, but never actually tried. It’s all about utility as Google in 2025 has had the year of the decade in terms of AI innovation (though I hate to admit it). This post is a portal to that world. 

BigAI’s Ecosystem 🌌

If ChatGPT is convenient and Anthropic’s Claude is pragmatic, Google Gemini and GDM’s various AI Products fills the gap between, and it’s quickly become a fairly wide array of products. Not all of them are that useful, but they are becoming more capable, cost-effective and gaining ground on rivals. 

In 2025, the way we conceive of search, research, content generation and discovering the physical world with AI has all suddenly transformed. This momentum in the late 2020s is only going to speed up. 

Rise of Gemini App 🌍

According to Google, while AI Overviews has 2 Billion users and Google Gemini now has in the area of 500 million monthly active users as of September, 2025. That’s catching up to ChatGPT fast. 

Access Gemini on the Web

With all these new AI capabilities this means it’s perhaps the best time to own a Pixel phone or Google device. Google Gemini is now the 2nd most popular AI product and AI app in the world just behind ChatGPT. It once seemed like ChatGPT had an insurmountable lead as a Generative AI chatbot, but in 2025 that’s become just another myth. 

AI Mode ✨

AI Mode the continuation of AI Overviews has been shipped out by default to more countries. 

AI Mode is new Search mode expands what AI Overviews can do with more advanced reasoning, thinking and multimodal capabilities so you can get help with even your toughest questions. You can ask anything on your mind and get a helpful AI-powered response with the ability to go further with follow-up questions and helpful web links.

AI Mode is a powerful, conversational AI-powered search experience in Google Search that allows users to ask complex, multi-part questions and get detailed, AI-generated responses with citations to web content.

Try AI Mode

NotebookLM ⚗️

NotebookLM is a AI-powered research assistant from Google that acts as a personalized virtual research assistant, allowing users to upload documents and other sources to get summaries, answer questions, and brainstorm ideas.

Some find it useful or even entertaining and educational. 

Google recently proposed: 6 ways to use NotebookLM to master any subject

Guides: 

How to use NotebookLM for personalized knowledge synthesis

How to Use Google's Deep Research, Learn About and NotebookLM Together

Agentic Design Patterns (Free Book) 📖

A senior AI engineer at Google just dropped a 400-page book for review: Agentic Design Patterns. If you want to learn more about AI agents this might be a good place to start. 

It’s got everything about AI agents + code:

Prompting

MCP

Tools

RAG

Memory

Humans in the loop

Multi-agent

Guardrails

You name it

You can read it here (Google Drive + links to chapters):

Read the Book

Google Labs 🔬

Google Labs is a platform where users can try and provide feedback on experimental features and products, particularly those involving artificial intelligence, to help shape their development. 

A space for experimentation:

Google Labs hosts experimental AI products and early-stage features from across the company.

A platform for feedback:

It allows users to get hands-on with these new ideas and provide direct feedback to the teams developing them.

A glimpse into the future:

Users can explore and try out cutting-edge AI technologies and help Google develop responsible and innovative tools.

Visit Google Labs

Flow 🎬

A new AI filmmaking tool that lets you seamlessly create cinematic clips, scenes and stories with consistency using Google’s most advanced AI models, including Veo 3.

Create with Flow

Genie 3, Google. Genie 3 🧞‍♀️

Genie 3 (released in August, 2025) is the latest "world model" AI from Google DeepMind that can generate interactive, physically consistent 3D virtual environments from simple text prompts. Users can navigate and interact with these dynamic, game-like worlds in real-time.

Real-time interactive worlds: Unlike models that produce only static images or pre-rendered videos, Genie 3 creates worlds that a user can explore and move through continuously. It generates these 3D environments at 720p resolution at 24 frames per second.

Promptable world events: Users can dynamically change the generated world by issuing new text commands while exploring it. For example, you can alter the weather, add new characters, or trigger other events on the fly.

Persistent visual memory: Genie 3 can remember changes and object locations in the environment for up to a minute, which helps maintain visual and physical consistency. If you paint a wall and then turn back to it later, the paint remains.

Learned physics: Rather than relying on a hard-coded physics engine like traditional video games, Genie 3 learns the rules of the world, such as how objects fall and collide, by observing massive datasets of videos. 

Learn More

Career Dreamer 💼

A new experimental tool that uses AI to make it easy to explore career possibilities personalized to your skills & interests. (Available only in the U.S. right now)

Try it Now

Shop with AI Mode

This is new shopping experience is rolling out in AI Mode, where shoppers can view product visuals and other AI-powered guidance that leverages product data. This is popular for both product discovery and travel plans. 

This is supposed to get us in the habit of using AI Mode. 

Google AI Pro 😎

Google AI Pro is a subscription plan offered by Google as part of its Google One service, providing enhanced access to Google's advanced AI tools and models. If you enjoy this article, you might want to get it if you foresee yourself using Google’s AI products more. Start your free trial.
